Considering the above considerations, the possible modes of implementation can broadly be divided into three categories, namely: a) Turnkey b) Discrete turnkey c) Non-turnkey The mode of implementation to be adopted for the project will depend on the resource availability at that time, considering the various ongoing and proposed projects in the region during the probable project implementation schedule. However, the actual mode of the implementation strategy to be followed against multiple packages will be at the discretion of Cliffs Burns Harbor at the time of actual project execution. 2.11 Safety Requirements During Project Construction The construction work for Civil, structural, and sheeting work for the proposed job will require the involvement of both skilled and unskilled construction workers, supervisory staff, managers, operators of construction machinery, etc. The workers new to this plant must be well-educated regarding safety. Providing safety awareness and training to these construction workers is one of the safety requirements. The plant, during its construction, will need in-built safety requirements to avoid injury to workers involved in various activities. It will be of utmost importance that the safety of all personnel is ensured during the plant's construction work. To fulfill the Occupational Health and Safety requirements of workers at construction sites, specific safety Attachment-6: Constructability Review 13 DE-FE0031937 / 0007 guidelines prepared by Cliffs Burns Harbor need to be followed. These guidelines are intended as a reference document for the contractors, who must develop their HSE assurance plan specific to the work awarded to them covering all the construction activities and submit the same to Cliffs Burns Harbor for approval. These guidelines may be in the form of checklists, work permits, and protocols for the construction activities associated with the project.
